status: frozen before any window was scored; amended once before scoring (see amendment) after acquisition showed Hyperliquid funding history starts in May 2023; run_study.py records this file's sha256 in results.json
candle_source: binanceus spot USDT pairs (M1 non-manifest path), proxy for Hyperliquid perpetual prices

selection_rule.eligible: every dataset of the group has at least min_training_trades trades and the M1 verdict is not funding_incomplete
selection_rule.objective: highest mean M1 ddadj (return_pct / |max_dd_pct|) across the group's datasets
selection_rule.fallback: no eligible combination keeps the registry seed for the candidate and the registry defaults for a comparator, recorded as seed_fallback

verdict_rules.scope: per interval group, on the confirmation windows with the locked selections
verdict_rules.unscorable_window: a confirmation window where any candidate leg, matched-exit comparator leg or incumbent-median dataset is funding_incomplete or missing; partial or off never substitutes
verdict_rules.insufficient_sample: fewer than min_confirmation_positions candidate positions across the scorable confirmation windows gives inconclusive

conditions.oos_pass: M1 verdict pass in oos; unknown when oos is unscorable
conditions.held_out_passes: M1 verdict pass in at least 2 of the 3 held-out windows; true once 2 scorable passes exist, false once scorable passes plus unscorable held-out windows are below 2, else unknown
conditions.net_pnl_positive: summed candidate net PnL across confirmation legs > 0; unknown when any confirmation window is unscorable
conditions.beats_comparators: candidate mean confirmation return_pct > each matched-exit comparator's; unknown when any confirmation window is unscorable
conditions.not_concentrated: largest single position net PnL <= 25% of the summed positive position PnL; unknown when any confirmation window is unscorable

verdict_rules.fail: adequate sample and at least one condition false
verdict_rules.inconclusive: insufficient sample, or no condition false while at least one is unknown
verdict_rules.overall: pass only if every group passes; fail only if every group fails; otherwise inconclusive
verdict_rules.metadata: pass keeps edge_source unvalidated pending separate approval; fail records study_fail; inconclusive records study_inconclusive; edge_status stays no_edge after every outcome

stability_sweep: exploratory only: the full candidate grid on every confirmation window after the confirmation run; never changes the selection or the verdict
amendment: Acquisition found no Hyperliquid funding rate before the venue's first record (2023-05-12 for BTC), so legs holding a position in early 2023 are funding-incomplete under charge. Before any scoring, the verdict rule changed from 'any incomplete confirmation leg gives inconclusive' to the three-valued rule below, so incomplete funding can never support a pass but complete windows can still establish a fail.
